name: Cheekwood Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer in the gardens and at the art museum. Roles include gardening and art projects. You can also greet visitors and help at special events.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 16 to 18 (18 only if still in high school). Younger teens (10 to 17) can volunteer through the Family Team program with a parent or other adult family member.
duration: The form asks if you can commit to at least one year
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted.
how_to_apply: Download and fill out the Teen Volunteer Application. Then do the orientation training you must take. Call the Volunteer Manager at 615-353-6966 with questions.
notes: The page says age 16 or older. The application form says ages 16, 17 and 18 if in high school. The form is dated June 2025, so ask the Volunteer Manager if it is the current form.
